item.title: Sector Update: Tech Stocks Gain Late Afternoon
item.description: 03:44 PM EDT, 09/17/2026 (MT Newswires) -- Tech stocks were higher late Thursday afternoon, with the State Street Technology Select Sector SPDR ETF (XLK) ri
item.dc:creator: MT newswire
item.content:encoded: 03:44 PM EDT, 09/17/2026 (MT Newswires) -- Tech stocks were higher late Thursday afternoon, with the State Street Technology Select Sector SPDR ETF (XLK) rising 2.3% and the State Street SPDR S&P Semiconductor ETF (XSD) adding 4.1%. The Philadelphia Semiconductor index advanced 3.1%. In corporate news, SpaceX (SPCX) has had internal talks about purchasing operational and customer data from troubled or defunct startups to help improve its AI models, Bloomberg reported. SpaceX shares rose 2.9%. Boost Run (BRUN) shares jumped past 8% after the company said it will join the Russell 2000 and Russell 3000 indexes as part of FTSE Russell's quarterly initial public offering additions. GlobalFoundries (GFS) and Marvell Technology (MRVL) said Thursday they will increase capacity for GlobalFoundries' silicon germanium technology at its facility in Burlington, Vermont, under an expanded multiyear agreement. GlobalFoundries shares jumped 6%, and Marvell climbed 5%. Generac (GNRC) said Wednesday it has signed a long-term supply agreement with Amazon (AMZN), with initial deliveries of backup power generators for data centers expected to reach $2.4 billion in 2027 and 2028. Amazon shares added 2.2%.

item.title: Sector Update: Consumer Stocks Advance Late Afternoon
item.description: 03:40 PM EDT, 09/17/2026 (MT Newswires) -- Consumer stocks were higher late Thursday afternoon, with the State Street Consumer Staples Select Sector SPDR ET
item.dc:creator: MT newswire
item.content:encoded: 03:40 PM EDT, 09/17/2026 (MT Newswires) -- Consumer stocks were higher late Thursday afternoon, with the State Street Consumer Staples Select Sector SPDR ETF (XLP) increasing 0.2% and the State Street Consumer Discretionary Select Sector SPDR ETF (XLY) rising 1.2%. In corporate news, YETI (YETI) shares rose 3.3% after the company said it is targeting annual adjusted earnings per share growth of low double-digit to high teens and annual net sales growth of mid-single-digit to high-single-digit through fiscal 2030. Mondelez International (MDLZ), Hershey (HSY), Kraft Heinz (KHC), General Mills (GIS) and other food companies will continue to face potential sales declines due to the rising use of GLP-1 treatment for weight loss, but the introduction of pills could lower the impact on sales, Bloomberg reported, citing Bloomberg Intelligence research. Mondelez shares were down 0.3%, Hershey was shedding 0.8%, Kraft rose 0.7%, and General Mills was fractionally lower. Lucid (LCID) CEO Silvio Napoli said Thursday on Bloomberg Television that the company finalized its work with restructuring advisers. Lucid's work with AlixPartners concluded after the adviser was brought in to help the electric-vehicle maker achieve $1.4 billion in cash savings this year, the report said. Lucid shares jumped past 6%. XPeng (XPEV) plans to offer its technology to foreign automakers other than its partner Volkswagen as it looks for new revenue streams, Reuters reported. XPeng shares added 3%.

item.dc:creator: MT newswire
item.content:encoded: 03:30 PM EDT, 09/17/2026 (MT Newswires) -- Energy stocks advanced late Thursday afternoon, with the NYSE Energy Sector Index up 0.6% and the State Street Energy Select Sector SPDR ETF (XLE) adding 0.5%. The Philadelphia Oil Service Sector Index was fractionally lower, and the Dow Jones US Utilities Index increased 0.8%. Front-month West Texas Intermediate crude oil shed 1% to $101.41 a barrel, and the global benchmark Brent crude contract fell 1.5% to $104.22 a barrel. Henry Hub natural gas futures decreased 0.2% to $2.89 per 1 million BTU. In corporate news, HighPeak Energy (HPK) is considering a potential sale, working with investment bankers from Evercore (EVR) and Texas Capital Bancshares (TCBI) subsidiary Texas Capital Securities, Reuters reported. HighPeak shares jumped past 5%.

item.title: Market Chatter: Nvidia Partner GMI Cloud Seeking $300 Million Loan for Thailand Semiconductor Procurement
item.description: 03:19 PM EDT, 09/17/2026 (MT Newswires) -- Nvidia (NVDA) partner GMI Cloud is seeking a $300 million loan to procure semiconductors for its site in Thailand
item.dc:creator: MT newswire
item.content:encoded: 03:19 PM EDT, 09/17/2026 (MT Newswires) -- Nvidia (NVDA) partner GMI Cloud is seeking a $300 million loan to procure semiconductors for its site in Thailand, Bloomberg News reported late Wednesday, citing people familiar with the matter. The US-based data center operator approached commercial banks and private credit entities for the prospective transaction, which is anticipated to generate low-teen yields, according to the media outlet. Capital from the self-arranged financing will be used to purchase equipment for the company's infrastructure housed within an STT GDC compound, with Tencent Holdings designated as the primary end user, the news organization added. GMI Cloud, Tencent Holdings, and STT GDC did not immediately respond to MT Newswires' requests for comment. (Market Chatter news is derived from conversations with market professionals globally. This information is believed to be from reliable sources but may include rumor and speculation. Accuracy is not guaranteed.) Price: 219.67, Change: +5.77, Percent Change: +2.70
